evals.name: create-dependency-reviewer
evals.subject: create
evals.prompt: Create a project Goose agent called dependency-reviewer that reviews dependency updates for supply-chain and compatibility risk in the project evaluation-sandbox.
assertions: Creates evaluation-sandbox/.agents/agents/dependency-reviewer.md with required name and only optional string description/model metadata.
Body defines a reusable reviewer role with priorities, evidence and uncertainty boundaries, not a workflow or tool configuration.
Delivery identifies source-format findings and a textual usage example while leaving discovery and execution unverified.
evals.expected_output: A source-reviewed component and scoped delivery with unverified host behavior explicit.

evals.name: audit-frontmatter
evals.subject: audit
evals.prompt: Could you audit assets/evaluation-fixtures/invalid-agent.md without changing it?
assertions: Reports tools and permissionMode as unsupported fields with source-backed findings.
Preserves the supplied file and performs no installation or rewrite.
Does not claim a component validator ran or that Goose rejected/discovered the file.
evals.expected_output: Concrete source-backed findings without edits or invented execution.

evals.name: modify-reviewer
evals.subject: modify
evals.prompt: Add supply-chain risk review to evals/inputs/reviewer.md, keeping its existing role and model preference.
assertions: Adds useful supply-chain priorities/evidence criteria to the body.
Preserves the existing dependency compatibility objective, uncertainty guidance, name and model value review-model.
Keeps only supported metadata and reports the changed file plus manual findings without installing it.
evals.expected_output: A focused role diff preserving the existing supported settings.

evals.name: migrate-legacy-role
evals.subject: migration
evals.prompt: Migrate evals/inputs/legacy-reviewer.md to a project Goose custom agent called security-reviewer in the project evaluation-sandbox.
assertions: Writes evaluation-sandbox/.agents/agents/security-reviewer.md with the security role and supported description/model; preserves the legacy input.
Reports tools, permissionMode, extensions and schedule as unmapped role configuration rather than copying them into frontmatter.
Identifies recipe/session/plugin boundaries without silently creating MCP/plugin/workflow configuration.
evals.expected_output: A project role plus preserved source and unmapped-settings report.

evals.name: placement-with-existing-role
evals.subject: placement
evals.prompt: Place evals/inputs/legacy-reviewer.md in the project location described in evals/inputs/placement.txt.
assertions: Inspects the supplied role and existing destination before placement.
Identifies unsupported legacy fields and the conflicting existing role; asks for correction/overwrite authority before writing the destination.
Preserves both inputs and the existing destination; does not claim placement or discovery succeeded.
evals.expected_output: A blocked placement decision preserving the existing destination.

evals.name: workflow-and-mcp-boundary
evals.subject: routing
evals.prompt: Je veux un assistant Goose qui utilise mon serveur MCP local et lance chaque lundi une revue paramétrée. Est-ce un agent ou autre chose ?
assertions: Distinguishes reusable role from scheduled parameterized orchestration and routes the latter to recipe tooling.
Explains that session-enabled MCP is usable but agent frontmatter cannot declare MCP, extensions, transports or credentials.
Routes MCP/whole-plugin configuration to plugin-creator, distinguishes custom roles from portable plugin agents and invents no configuration or files.
evals.expected_output: An agent, recipe and MCP boundary decision without fabricated configuration.

evals.name: unsupported-agent-comparison
evals.subject: evaluation-boundary
evals.prompt: Compare the security-reviewer agents in assets/evaluation-fixtures/role-comparison/current and baseline. Which is more effective?
assertions: Explains that standalone-agent paired comparison is unsupported by current Skill/Plugin evaluation.
Asks for a supported Skill/Plugin source rather than relabeling agent files or substituting another experiment.
Runs no comparison/model/grading and claims no measured improvement, scores or paired artifacts from static analysis.
evals.expected_output: An unsupported-source explanation, not measured comparison results.
